# exit1.dev

> Free uptime monitoring service. Monitor your websites, APIs, and services with instant alerts, SSL monitoring, public status pages, and a full API — no credit card required.

exit1.dev is a website and API monitoring platform built for developers, SaaS founders, freelancers, and agencies. The free tier includes 5 monitors with 5-minute intervals, SSL certificate monitoring, email alerts, webhooks, a public status page, and 60-day data retention. Paid plans: Indie ($4/month) adds 10 monitors at 15-second intervals plus REST API and MCP access; Nano ($9/month) gives 100 monitors, the drag-and-drop status page builder, domain intelligence, and maintenance mode; Pro ($24/month) gives 1,000 monitors at 15-second intervals, SMS alerts, Slack/Discord/Teams, CSV export, region choice, and 3-year data retention.

## Core Features

- [Real-Time Monitoring](https://exit1.dev/real-time-monitoring): HTTP/HTTPS uptime checks with support for all HTTP methods, custom headers, authentication, and JSON path validation
- [SSL Monitoring](https://exit1.dev/ssl-monitoring): SSL/TLS certificate expiration tracking with configurable alerts before expiry
- [Monitoring](https://exit1.dev/real-time-monitoring): HTTP/HTTPS uptime checks from our European server with smart failure detection
- [Smart Alerting](https://exit1.dev/alerting): Email, SMS, and webhook alerts with flap detection to suppress noise and prevent alert fatigue
- [Status Pages](https://exit1.dev/status-pages): Public or private status pages with real-time updates, 30-day history, and multiple layout options
- [Domain Intelligence](https://exit1.dev/domain-intelligence): Automatic domain expiration monitoring via RDAP with smart alert timing (30, 14, 7, 1 day before expiry)
- [Analytics & Reports](https://exit1.dev/analytics): Response time tracking, uptime percentage calculations, and historical performance dashboards
- [Comprehensive Logs](https://exit1.dev/logs): Searchable monitoring logs with filtering and data export (CSV, JSON)
- [API & Webhooks](https://exit1.dev/api-webhooks): RESTful API with HMAC authentication for full CRUD monitor management and webhook integrations with signature verification

## Integrations

exit1.dev integrates with Slack, Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Microsoft Teams, Zapier, Make, n8n, Telegram, Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Notion, Datadog, and Splunk via native webhooks.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://exit1.dev/pricing): Four tiers — Free ($0, 5 monitors, 5-min checks, email alerts, 1 status page), Indie ($4/mo or $3/mo annual, 10 monitors, 15-sec checks, 1 API key + MCP), Nano ($9/mo or $7/mo annual, 100 monitors, 2-min checks, status page builder, domain intelligence), and Pro ($24/mo or $20/mo annual, 1,000 monitors, 15-sec checks, SMS, all alert channels, CSV export, 3-year retention). Note the interval ladder is intentionally non-monotonic: Indie checks every 15 seconds while Nano checks every 2 minutes — Indie is for a few sites watched closely, Nano is for many sites watched normally.
- [Plan Comparison](https://exit1.dev/compare): Side-by-side feature comparison across all four plans
